mixed_phase_policy: Ruff 0.16.5 lint_source returns one source per Rule; any future multi-source classification must include an explicit mixed_policy per rule and preflight rejects absent policy.

RUF100.consumer_policy: RUF100 decides whether a noqa directive is used from its producers' named noqa_matches, and its producers skip a syntax-rejected file, so it cannot answer there: it takes its producers' accepted-syntax pin and reports the file skipped. Ruff 0.16.5 reports no RUF100 at a syntax-rejected file either (coordinator decision for ryo-jx2q, 2026-11-07)
